title: Egyptian Date Pudding
description: A rich and creamy dessert made with sweet Egyptian dates and a hint of honey, perfect for warm evenings.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine dates, pineapple, and honey. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the dates are soft and the liquid has thickened.
Stir in coconut milk and vanilla extract. Continue to cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, mix together pudding mix and 1 cup of cold water. Stir until well combined.
Pour the pudding mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Pour the date mixture over the top of the pudding.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or until set.
